description: This file defines the KinesisClient class for interacting with Amazon Kinesis service, including method annotations for various stream operations.

classes.name: KinesisClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with Amazon Kinesis service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: addTagsToStream
methods.description: Adds tags to a specified stream.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new Kinesis data stream.

methods.name: decreaseStreamRetentionPeriod
methods.description: Decreases the retention period of a stream.

methods.name: describeLimits
methods.description: Describes the current limits for the account.

methods.name: describeStreamSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of the stream.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Retrieves data entries from a shard.

methods.name: putRecord
methods.description: Puts a data record into a stream.

methods.name: putRecords
methods.description: Puts multiple data records into a stream.

methods.name: putResourcePolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a resource policy.
